semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in chemical analysis equipment and methods that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: New Fast Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the integration of equipment and the development of trace analysis methods for chemical analysis, particularly in the semiconductor sector. They provide precision instruments and systems for gas chromatography, mass spectrometry, and liquid chromatography, addressing challenges such as VOC micro-contamination and trace metal contamination monitoring.
